component.name: LocalSend GTK
component.summary: An open-source cross-platform alternative to AirDrop (GTK4/Wayland)

description.p: LocalSend GTK is a native Linux client for LocalSend built with GTK4, Libadwaita, and Rust. It enables secure file and message sharing between devices on your local network without an internet connection.

ul.li: End-to-end encryption with HTTPS and pinned certificates
Native GTK4 and Libadwaita interface with standard dark/light mode and Material 3 accents
Native Wayland rendering and GTK display scaling
Interactive desktop notifications for incoming transfers
Drag-and-drop integration with Linux file managers
LocalSend protocol support for sharing with official mobile and desktop clients

description.p: Native GTK4 client with corrected receive confirmation, IP address connections and an animated receive logo.
